svg.aria-label: ADR-005: a data composition is a directed acyclic graph of typed operators from licensed sources to a hashed sink; every node is content addressed and the sink's hash is the mix hash; two runs are comparable only when they share it; decontamination is a bit vector algebra; five invariants are enforced by tests; the engine never chooses the mix
svg.title: ADR-005 — The data composition layer: a hashed graph of typed operators, comparable by its mix hash
svg.text: The data composition layer: a hashed graph of typed operators, and "at equal data" becomes a fact
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-005. Before architectures are compared, the data terrain is a declared, hashed, reproducible object; the engine never chooses a mix.
Decisions one and two: a composition is a graph, every node is content addressed
source
a licensed corpus or shard,
content addressed, licence declared
source
another licensed corpus,
its licence verified at ingestion
unary transforms
filter, dedup, decontaminate,
normalize: one stream in, one out
within a source
repeat, bounded; rephrase, by synthesis;
upsample: the distribution within it
combinators
mix, concat, interleave, sample:
actions that fuse streams
the sink
the final byte stream,
hashed: the mix hash
each node's hash = a function of its operator, its parameters and its inputs' hashes; the sink's hash is the mix hash
two runs are comparable if and only if they share the mix hash: "at equal data" is machine checkable, not a declaration;
two graphs differing by one operator are comparable on that one difference: the graph is the ablation axis and the provenance
the manifest, committed and human readable, is the recipe; execution is lazy and streaming, no intermediate materialised;
a node computed once is never recomputed, specified now and built when a second mix shares a subtree;
the run record carries the mix hash, and the existing control receives it retroactively, without retraining
Decision seven: the invariant harness, built first

g.text: identity: a mix of one source is that source
duplication idempotence: a mix of a source with itself is that source,
at the byte stream and at the hash
(the founder's "run the same thing twice" test)
commutativity: the order of sources does not change the mix, at equal seed
determinism: same graph, same seed, same hash, twice running
decontamination: a planted trap token in training is detected

svg.text: Decision four: decontamination as a bit vector algebra

g.text: evaluation sequences must not appear in the training data; each source's
set of word sequences as a bit vector signature, a probabilistic set filter:
set operations are then bitwise; union: the mix of sources;
intersection of training and evaluation: contamination, detected at once
difference: in training and not in the evaluation set
a mix that fails decontamination is not comparable; the report is archived

svg.text: Decisions five and six: the mix weight
a weight is a share of a bounded token budget:
mixing redistributes, it never inflates; identical sources
are folded by their content hash before sampling, so a
duplicate is recognised, not re drawn; the weight's resolver
sits behind a seam: a declared constant today,
a value read from the frontier later
Decision eight: legality, three things kept distinct
the engine: written from scratch, our own, zero borrowed lines
the data: licensed corpora, each source declaring its licence
in the manifest, attribution honoured
the recipes: ideas and methods, credited, re implemented,
never copied
What the engine never does
it does not choose the winning mix: whether a mix makes
a better model is an empirical question answered only
by the ledger and the frontier; the processing bottleneck
is removed by construction; the results bottleneck is
solved by no engine cleverness, only by the ledger and the frontier
the first slice, the interface and the five invariants, is built from the start; memoisation, the large scale bit vector cross check and the frontier read weight wait for the wave that exercises them
